text:
Sam: Heads-up — AcmeCorp asked to onboard lyra-11b (fp16 checkpoint) for a Private deployment. They expect ~1k token avg and want p50 < 200ms. Request came in via support ticket #5823. Priority: high for Q2 launch. They uploaded weights to s3://acme-ld/lyra-11b/. Can we triage?
Anika: Added to the intake board. Do we have any baseline evals vs our phoenix-8b or existing 11b variants?
Sam: They ran internal evals: comparable ROUGE/EM but higher hallucination on instruction-style prompts. They want int8 quant so the model fits on 2xA10G.
Jorge: I'll take the smoke tests. Plan: run 50 prompts from our toxicity+qa promptset and a 100-sample instruction eval. ETA 24h.
Maya: Also flagging sequence length — they use 1k, so KV cache mem could be tight. If int8 degrades quality we may need to try per-channel quant or QAT. Also compliance: they mentioned PII in some prompts; loop in security.
Eli: Batching won't help much at 1k tokens. Recommend single-request fast path on Dedicated with prewarmed KV cache. I'll bench 1xA10G vs 2xA10G for p50/p95.
Anika: Triage fields set: SLA p50=200ms, p95=600ms; cost target <$0.015/token. Owner: Jorge. Eval tags: hallucination, safety, seqlen-1k.
Sam: Here's a quick snippet they shared for conversion and quant: 
```bash
python scripts/quantize.py --model s3://acme-ld/lyra-11b/ --out /tmp/lyra-int8 --backend triton --mode per_channel
```
Jorge: Copy. I'll run both per-channel int8 and a symmetric int8 run. If eval regression >5% absolute F1 on our instruction set, we'll escalate to research for QAT. cc @ML-Oncall-Bot for canary window scheduling.
ML-Oncall-Bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-03-25 03:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying eng-runtime and infra owners.
Maya: Once smoke and perf pass, follow onboarding checklist: create model card, run vuln/PII scan, add KMS bindings, set rollout policy (canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%), and prepare rollback artifact.
Sam: Thanks — ping me if you need the support ticket or the customer's contact. I'll keep the customer updated on ETA.
Jorge: Starting perf+eval runs now. Will post results and a short artifacts list (profiles, quant configs, eval CSV) in this thread when done.
Maya: :thumbsup:
